verdict.rationale: Firebase Security Rules are documented as a configuration language that defines what data each user can access across Firestore, Realtime Database and Cloud Storage. They integrate with Authentication to grant user-based permissions, can be as granular as the app needs, and can be tested in the emulator via the Test SDK. Community users independently praise the rules for cleanly separating access policy from data logic. Missing for 10: concrete rule syntax or examples in the evidence showing per-user document matching (e.g., checks on the authenticated user ID).
